entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dotnet-watch] AspireLauncherTests.ServerAndResources may fail due to race condition #53718
  • `dotnet restore` fails on Arm64 with `PublishAot` #53713

Closed

  • dotnet format broken in SDK 10.0.200 - TypeInitializationException in Microsoft.Build.Shared.XMakeElements #53383

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix dotnet tool runner stripping duplicate flags when rollForward is enabled #53725
  • Validate descriptor from registry + add tests for descriptor resolution #53724
    Area-Containers
  • Fix nuget subcommand --help forwarding to NuGet CLI #53723
  • Update Azure Linux 3.0 RID mapping #53722
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add validation script and nested AGENTS.md to enforce agent skill quality #53721
  • Increase memory for license scanning #53720
    Branch Lockdown
  • Update SDK PR guide with servicing branch details #53719
  • Remove duplicate @ prefix from issueAuthor in GitOps #53717
  • Enhance fish shell completions with static+dynamic hybrid generation #53716
  • [Experimental] Update GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles task to generate Hot Reload … #53715
  • Fix xUnit1051: pass TestContext.Current.CancellationToken to async methods #53714
  • Add #:item directive support #53712

Merged

  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53696
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'main' #53580
    Area-VMR
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53694
    Area-Infrastructure

Updated

  • Add /tactics comment-triggered workflow for servicing PRs #53596
  • Introduce a property to specify assemblies that should be partially R2R compiled and excluded from a composite image. #53635
    Area-ReadyToRun, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Use OTel for telemetry #53181
    Area-CLI
  • Fix dnx not authenticating for private feeds #53322
  • [watch] Fixes command line parsing and TFM selection for FBAs #53698
  • Fix reporting Hot Reload capabilities of WASM projects #53665
  • Rewrite Copilot instructions and move to AGENTS.md #53630
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Implement `#:ref` directive for file-based apps #53480
    Area-run-file
  • Only download runtimes for referenced frameworks #53518
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Add BundledRuntimeAssetRuntimeIdentifiers to filter runtimes/ folder assets by RID allow-list #53140
    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-NetSDK
  • docs: explain why publishing a solution is discouraged #53693
